Finally heard, go write everybody https://t.co/pj0RUS0HTT

↳ Improvements to token efficiency & behavior in Grok Bot are underway

Many of you have built important workflows on @bot - we want to keep supporting you

Please reply with feedback on this post. I will read it all

Thank you sincerely for your support https://t.co/vTJ2xf8Vvq

I am moving out of Grok bot. 

So disappointed with what happened. 

Having my grok bot review all work and over 3,000 substantive original work items were found. 

I am making a document to give it all away. 

I would have kept working in Grok Bot had the team not dismantled and destroyed what was good in the last 48 hours. 

*Please not that I was the one that defended Grok Bot when everyone was attacking it and saying how the rates changed. 

Truth is more efficient than deceit. 

I will never again trust a single closed lab. 

None of the “labs” can be trusted. 

Not one. 

I am scared to even try Muse. So why bother? •

Holy hell Grok @bot - people really aren’t kidding with their usage complaints.

This is after 5 easy questions and my morning brief. 

No way is this going to work… https://t.co/fUNfeyeYud

I am usually not one to complain

But the Grok Bot usage situation is bad

I used all of my usage for the week in less than 24 hours

And then I spent an additional $50 to try to finish and ship a new version of my personal app

$50 gone… poof… and the work didn’t even get finished

It’s been the perfect storm of a usage nerf and a significant capability drop

@Bot team please help us

I feel like a part of me has died

Stranded with no usage

After 2 weeks of intense playing around with Grok Bot I can confidently say: it’s unusable right now.

My limit is vanishing super fast and the model looks stupid.

Moved from awesome tool to stupid tool really fast.

Time to test new things. https://t.co/9xx9lA2izY
